title: Research connector must remain non-blocking and optional
cause: A third-party TTS model or network source could accidentally become a blocking runtime dependency.
fix: Queue documentation-only fetches in an isolated daemon worker; preserve independent sources and no automatic production promotion.

title: TTS render failure
symptom: ElevenLabs disabled: supply your API key and per-character voice IDs; usage may be billable.
fix: Install/configure a supported backend and rerun the regression case
prevention: Preflight backend, model file, credentials and output validation before batch render
note: Known issue reappeared; block release until regression test passes.
